## Allele specific expression ###
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

base_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/quantification/counts"
sample_folders <- list.dirs(base_dir, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE) # Get all folder names (sample IDs)
all_quant_data <- list() # Initialize empty list to store data

# Loop through each folder
for (sample_id in sample_folders) {
  quant_file_path <- file.path(base_dir, sample_id, "quant.genes.sf")
  if (file.exists(quant_file_path)) {
    quant_file <- read.csv(quant_file_path, sep = "\t") # Check the files exist and read files 
    
    # Calculate total reads for this sample
    total_reads <- sum(quant_file$NumReads)
    
    # Extract genome and ID from the sequence 
    quant_file$genome <- sub(".*_([^_]+)$", "\\1", quant_file$Name) 
    quant_file$ID <- sub("_[^_]+$", "", quant_file$Name)
    
    # Add sample ID column
    quant_file$sample_id <- sample_id
    
    # Store in list
    all_quant_data[[sample_id]] <- quant_file
    cat("Processed:", sample_id, "| Total reads:", total_reads, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("File not found:", quant_file_path, "\n")
  }
}

# Combine all data into one dataframe
combined_quant_data <- bind_rows(all_quant_data)

# Pivot to have separate columns for each genome - TPM
wide_tpm_data <- combined_quant_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, genome, sample_id, TPM) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(sample_id, genome), 
    values_from = TPM,
    names_sep = "_"
  )

# Pivot to have separate columns for each genome - NumReads
wide_counts_data <- combined_quant_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, genome, sample_id, NumReads) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(sample_id, genome), 
    values_from = NumReads,
    names_sep = "_"
  )

# View the results
head(wide_tpm_data)
head(wide_counts_data)

# Reshape for analysis with both TPM and NumReads
reshaped_allele_specific_expr <- combined_quant_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, sample_id, genome, TPM, NumReads) %>%
  mutate(sample_clean = as.numeric(sample_id))

head(reshaped_allele_specific_expr)
write.csv2(reshaped_allele_specific_expr,"/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/quantification/counts/reshaped_allele_specific_expr.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
### Import RSEM ### 
```{r}
# Set base directory for RSEM results
rsem_base_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/quantification_rsem"

# Get all .genes.results files
rsem_files <- list.files(rsem_base_dir, pattern = "\\.genes\\.results$", full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize empty list to store data
all_rsem_data <- list()

# Loop through each file
for (file_path in rsem_files) {
  # Extract sample ID from filename
  sample_id <- sub("\\.genes\\.results$", "", basename(file_path))
  
  if (file.exists(file_path)) {
    # Read RSEM file
    rsem_file <- read.csv(file_path, sep = "\t")
    
    # Calculate total reads for this sample
    total_reads <- sum(rsem_file$expected_count)
    
    # Extract genome and ID from gene_id
    rsem_file$genome <- sub(".*_([^_]+)$", "\\1", rsem_file$gene_id)
    rsem_file$ID <- sub("_[^_]+$", "", rsem_file$gene_id)
    
    # Add sample ID column
    rsem_file$sample_id <- sample_id
    
    # Store in list
    all_rsem_data[[sample_id]] <- rsem_file
    cat("Processed:", sample_id, "| Total reads:", total_reads, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("File not found:", file_path, "\n")
  }
}

# Combine all data into one dataframe
combined_rsem_data <- bind_rows(all_rsem_data)

# Pivot to have separate columns for each genome - TPM
combined_rsem_data <- combined_rsem_data %>% dplyr::select(genome, ID, sample_id, TPM,expected_count)
## Create genome type 
combined_rsem_data$genome_type <- ifelse(combined_rsem_data$genome == "tair10", "tair10", "accession")
```

## Filter gene and TEs to have at least n reads per condition 
```{r}
# Calculate 5% of samples threshold
total_samples <- length(unique(reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo$sample_id))
min_samples_threshold <- ceiling(total_samples * 0.05)  # 5% of samples

cat("Total samples:", total_samples, "\n")
cat("Minimum samples threshold (5%):", min_samples_threshold, "\n")

# Filter: NumReads >= 10 in at least 5% of samples
reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered <- reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(samples_above_10reads = sum(expected_count >= 10)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(samples_above_10reads >= min_samples_threshold) %>%
  dplyr::select(-samples_above_10reads) %>%
  ungroup()

str(unique(reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered$ID))
```

## Visualize expression patterns in genes and tes (scatterplot) for controls
```{r}
reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered$status <- ifelse(
  grepl("TE", reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered$ID), 
  "TE", 
  "gene"
)
## Get controls 
reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered_control <- reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered[reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered$Accession==6909,]

## Mark duplicates
duplicates <- reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered_control %>%
  group_by(ID, sample_id, Accession, Variant, Genotype, status, genome_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n > 1L)
str(unique(duplicates$ID)) ## Summarise duplicates 

# Remove duplicates by keeping only distinct rows 
reshaped_data_cleaned <- reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered_control %>%
  distinct(ID, sample_id, Accession, Variant, Genotype, status, genome_type, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Reshape 
reshaped_wide <- reshaped_data_cleaned %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(ID, sample_id, Accession, Variant, Genotype, status),
    names_from = genome_type,
    values_from = c(TPM, expected_count),
    names_sep = "_"
  )

# View result
reshaped_wide %>% 
    filter(status == "TE" ) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(log2(TPM_accession + 1), log2(TPM_tair10 + 1))) +  
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~Genotype + sample_id) 
```

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(tidyverse)

# Prepare heatmap data
heatmap_data <- boxplot_data_filtered %>% 
  mutate(sample_genome = paste(sample_id, genome_type, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, sample_genome, log2_TPM) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_genome, values_from = log2_TPM, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ID") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Create annotation data for columns
col_annotation <- boxplot_data_filtered %>%
  mutate(sample_genome = paste(sample_id, genome_type, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_genome, Genotype, Variant, genome_type) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_genome")

# Match order to heatmap columns
col_annotation <- col_annotation[colnames(heatmap_data), ]

# Define colors - FIXED: changed variable names
genome_colors <- c("accession" = "#E41A1C", "tair10" = "#377EB8")
variant_colors <- c("Col" = "#66C2A5", "ddm1" = "#FC8D62")

# Create top annotation - FIXED: changed Genotype to Genome in the list
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Genome = col_annotation$genome_type,
  Variant = col_annotation$Variant,
  col = list(
    Genome = genome_colors,      # FIXED: was "Genotype"
    Variant = variant_colors
  ),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

# Create heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  name = "log2(TPM+1)",
  top_annotation = col_ha,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_method_rows = "complete",
  clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
  clustering_method_columns = "complete",
  row_km_repeats = 1000,
  column_km_repeats = 1000,
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  column_title = "TE Expression Heatmap",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "log2(TPM+1)",
    direction = "vertical",
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm")
  )
)
# Draw heatmap
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
```
### Get maternally expressed TEs 
## Calculate maternal ratios 
```{r}
## Filter out TEs which are not expressed in either of the genomes
# Transform to wide format first
tpm_wide <- boxplot_data_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, Variant, Genotype, ID, genome_type, TPM) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = genome_type,
    values_from = TPM,
    names_prefix = "TPM_"
  )

# Calculate maternal ratios
tpm_ratios <- tpm_wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_TPM = TPM_accession + TPM_tair10,
    tair10_ratio = ifelse(total_TPM == 0, NA, TPM_tair10 / total_TPM),
    accession_ratio = ifelse(total_TPM == 0, NA, TPM_accession / total_TPM)
  )

# View results
head(tpm_ratios)
```

## Write TEs with maternal ratio >=0.7
```{r}
average_ratios_morethan07 <- average_ratios[average_ratios$avg_ratio >= 0.7, ] %>% na.omit()

# Prepare data for correlation
te_variant_means <- boxplot_data_filtered %>%
  filter(genome_type == "tair10") %>%
  group_by(ID, Variant) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_log2_TPM = mean(log2_TPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Variant, values_from = mean_log2_TPM) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Col) & !is.na(ddm1)) %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC = abs(ddm1 - Col),
    different = log2FC > 0.5  # TRUE if >2-fold different
  )


# Keep only TEs that are different between Col and ddm1
tes_to_keep <- te_variant_means %>%
  filter(different == TRUE) %>%
  pull(ID)

# Filter original data
boxplot_data_filtered_different <- boxplot_data_filtered %>%
  filter(ID %in% tes_to_keep)

# Number of TEs per variant and accession
# Count per TE
tes_count <- boxplot_data_filtered_different %>%filter(ID %in% average_ratios_morethan07$ID) %>%
  group_by(Variant) %>%
  summarise(
    n_TEs = n_distinct(ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tes_count

## Plot heatmap 
heatmap_data <- boxplot_data_filtered_different %>% filter(ID %in% average_ratios_morethan07$ID) %>%
  mutate(sample_genome = paste(sample_id, genome_type, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, sample_genome, log2_TPM) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_genome, values_from = log2_TPM, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ID") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Create annotation with sorted order
col_annotation <- boxplot_data_filtered_different %>%
  #filter(ID %in% average_ratios_morethan07$ID) %>%
  mutate(sample_genome = paste(sample_id, genome_type, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_genome, Genotype, Variant, genome_type) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(genome_type == "accession", Variant == "ddm1") %>%  # Sort: tair10 first, then Col first
  column_to_rownames("sample_genome")

# Reorder heatmap data to match
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[, rownames(col_annotation)]

# Define colors
# Create annotation with sorted order - first by Genotype, then by genome
col_annotation <- boxplot_data_filtered_different %>%
    filter(ID %in% average_ratios_morethan07$ID) %>%
    mutate(sample_genome = paste(sample_id, genome_type, sep = "_")) %>%
    dplyr::select(sample_genome, Genotype, Variant, genome_type) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(Genotype, genome_type == "accession") %>%  # Sort: Genotype first, then tair10 before accession
    column_to_rownames("sample_genome")

# Reorder heatmap data to match
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[, rownames(col_annotation)]

genome_colors <- c("accession" = "#E41A1C", "tair10" = "#377EB8")
genotype_colors <- c("F1_Col" = "#66C2A5", "F1_ddm1" = "#E62727", "ct_col" = "#5D866C", "ddm1_ct" = "#FFD93D")

# Create top annotation - genotype first (top), then genome (bottom)
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    genotype = col_annotation$Genotype,
    'Mapped haplotype' = col_annotation$genome_type,
    col = list(
        genotype = genotype_colors,
        'Mapped haplotype' = genome_colors
    ),
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

# Create heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
    heatmap_data,
    name = "log2(TPM+1)",
    top_annotation = col_ha,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
    clustering_method_rows = "complete",
    row_km_repeats = 1000,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    column_title = "Samples",
    row_title = "TE",
    column_title_side = "bottom",
    row_title_side = "left",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4),
    row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
        title = "log2(TPM+1)",
        direction = "vertical",
        legend_height = unit(4, "cm")
    )
)

draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")

  mutate(sample_genome = paste(Sample_id, genome, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, sample_genome, log2_TPM) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_genome, values_from = log2_TPM, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ID")

# Perform PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(t(pca_data), scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)

# Get variance explained
variance_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, ] * 100

# Create plot data
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
pca_scores$sample_genome <- rownames(pca_scores)
pca_scores$Sample_id <- sub("_.*", "", pca_scores$sample_genome)
pca_scores$genome <- sub(".*_", "", pca_scores$sample_genome)

# Add metadata
metadata <- boxplot_data_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_id, genome, Genotype) %>%
  distinct()

pca_scores <- merge(pca_scores, metadata, by = c("Sample_id", "genome"))

# Plot
ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Genotype, shape = genome)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(variance_explained[1], 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(variance_explained[2], 2), "%)"),
    title = "PCA of TE Expression"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


```

## PCA on each superfamily
```{r}
# Get unique superfamilies
superfamilies <- unique(boxplot_data_filtered_with_family$Transposon_Super_Family)
 
# Create a list to store PCA results
pca_plots <- list()

# Loop through each superfamily
for (sf in superfamilies) {
  
  # Filter data for this superfamily
  sf_data <- boxplot_data_filtered_with_family %>%
    filter(Transposon_Super_Family == sf) %>%
    filter(ID %in% average_ratios_morethan07$ID)
  
  # Skip if too few genes
  if (length(unique(sf_data$ID)) < 3) {
    message(paste("Skipping", sf, "- too few genes"))
    next
  }
  
  # Prepare PCA data
  pca_data <- sf_data %>%
    mutate(sample_genome = paste(Sample_id, genome, sep = "_")) %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, sample_genome, log2_TPM) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = sample_genome, values_from = log2_TPM, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("ID")
  
  # Perform PCA
  pca_result <- prcomp(t(pca_data), scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  
  # Get variance explained
  variance_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, ] * 100
  
  # Create plot data
  pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
  pca_scores$sample_genome <- rownames(pca_scores)
  pca_scores$Sample_id <- sub("_.*", "", pca_scores$sample_genome)
  pca_scores$genome <- sub(".*_", "", pca_scores$sample_genome)
  
  # Add metadata
  metadata <- sf_data %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample_id, genome, Genotype) %>%
    distinct()
  
  pca_scores <- merge(pca_scores, metadata, by = c("Sample_id", "genome"))
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Genotype, shape = genome)) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(variance_explained[1], 2), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(variance_explained[2], 2), "%)"),
      title = paste("PCA -", sf, "Superfamily")
    ) +
    theme_bw()
  
  # Store plot
  pca_plots[[sf]] <- p
  
  # Print plot
  print(p)
}

# Optional: Combine plots using patchwork or gridExtra
library(patchwork)
wrap_plots(pca_plots, ncol = 2)
```

## Check Leandro's genes 
```{r}
## Read leandro's upstream genes affected by TE insertion 
insertions_upstream_gene <- readxl::read_excel("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/dynamets/01_data/SPM_insertions_upstream_genes_leandro.xlsx")
```
## Calculate  presence for every accession
```{r}
insertions_upstream_gene_long <- insertions_upstream_gene %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Chr, Start_ins, Stop_ins, TE_family, Allele_freq, Chr_TSS, 
              feature, Start_TSS, Stop_TSS, Orientation_gene, gene, Distance_to_TSS),
    names_to = "Accession",
    values_to = "Value", 
    values_transform = list(Value=~as.numeric(na_if(.,"NA")))
  )
# Modify gene
insertions_upstream_gene_long$gene_id <- gsub("ID=", "", insertions_upstream_gene_long$gene)
insertions_upstream_gene_long$gene_id <- gsub( ";.*" , "", insertions_upstream_gene_long$gene_id)
```
## Get accessions with presence and absence
```{r}
insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value <- as.numeric(insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value)
insertions_upstream_gene_long_presence_acc <- insertions_upstream_gene_long[insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value==1 & !is.na(insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value),] # Select only presence 
insertions_upstream_gene_long_presence_acc$status <- "presence"

insertions_upstream_gene_long_absence_acc <- insertions_upstream_gene_long[insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value==0 & !is.na(insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value),] # Select only absence 
insertions_upstream_gene_long_absence_acc$status <- "absence"
```
## Connect to the expression dataset presence absence variation
```{r}
insertions_upstream_gene_long_presence_acc$Accession <- as.numeric(insertions_upstream_gene_long_presence_acc$Accession)
boxplot_data_filtered_genes_acc_presence <- inner_join(boxplot_data_filtered_genes,insertions_upstream_gene_long_presence_acc,by=c("Accession"="Accession", "ID"="gene_id"))

insertions_upstream_gene_long_absence_acc$Accession <- as.numeric(insertions_upstream_gene_long_absence_acc$Accession)
boxplot_data_filtered_genes_acc_absence<- inner_join(boxplot_data_filtered_genes,insertions_upstream_gene_long_absence_acc,by=c("Accession"="Accession", "ID"="gene_id"))
```
## Visualize presence absence 
```{r}
insertions_upstream_gene_long_presence_acc_mean <- boxplot_data_filtered_genes_acc_presence %>% 
  group_by(ID, Genotype, status) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_expr_acc = mean(log2_TPM & genome_type=="accession"),
    mean_expr_tair = mean(log2_TPM & genome_type=="tair10"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% ungroup()

insertions_upstream_gene_long_absence_acc_mean <- boxplot_data_filtered_genes_acc_absence %>% 
  group_by(ID, Genotype, status) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_expr_acc = mean(log2_TPM & genome_type=="accession"),
    mean_expr_tair = mean(log2_TPM & genome_type=="tair10"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% ungroup()

library(dplyr)

# Combine the datasets with a label
combined_data <- bind_rows(
    insertions_upstream_gene_long_presence_acc_mean %>% mutate(insertion_status = "Presence"),
    insertions_upstream_gene_long_absence_acc_mean %>% mutate(insertion_status = "Absence")
)

# Boxplot for accession
combined_data %>%
  #filter(genome_type == "accession") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = insertion_status, y = log2_TPM, fill = insertion_status)) +
  geom_boxplot() +  # Add + here
  facet_wrap(~genome_type + TE_family) +  # Use + not ~ between variables
  labs(title = "Gene Expression: Insertion Presence vs Absence",
       x = "Insertion Status", y = "log2(TPM+1)") +
  theme_bw()
# T-test or Wilcoxon test
library(ggpubr)

combined_data %>%
  filter(genome_type == "accession") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = insertion_status, y = log2_TPM, fill = insertion_status)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test") +
  facet_wrap(~Variant) +
  labs(title = "Gene Expression, Presence-Absence") +
  theme_bw()

```
